source.name: NBA Communications (pr.nba.com): BAL and Rwanda Development Board multi-year extension
source.quote: Visit Rwanda will continue to be showcased on BAL team uniforms and at the BAL Combine.
source.note: League-wide uniform branding from the RDB extension that keeps the BAL Finals in Kigali through 2026; the BAL's own 2026 team photo of the Flyers (https://cdn-bal.nba.com/manage/sites/3/2026/02/Flyers-scaled.jpg) shows 'VISIT RWANDA' on the chest beneath the FLYERS wordmark. The 17 Mar 2026 PUMA release (Zawya) still lists the Rwanda Development Board as a Foundational Partner for the 2026 season.

source.name: Zawya (APO Group, on behalf of the BAL): Basketball Africa League Names PUMA as League's Official Outfitter Ahead of 2026 Season
source.quote: will see PUMA supply all official BAL team, fan and referee apparel, including game uniforms, warm-up gear, practice wear, accessories
source.note: Kit maker, recorded as partner per existing convention: the collaboration begins with the 2026 BAL season, and the PUMA logo sits on the right chest of the 2026 BAL game uniform in the BAL's own team photo of the Flyers (https://cdn-bal.nba.com/manage/sites/3/2026/02/Flyers-scaled.jpg).

source.name: Arab News: Qatar Foundation and Basketball Africa League to drive social impact through sport
source.quote: with QF’s Sidra tree logo featuring on all BAL team uniforms
source.note: Arab News states the placement on all BAL team uniforms (the live page blocks scripted access, so the Wayback capture of 15 May 2026 is cited). The position on the upper back beside the number is visible on a BAL Season 6 game jersey in the league's own Day 12 recap photo (https://cdn-bal.nba.com/manage/sites/3/2026/04/maxresdefault-73.jpg), which shows FUS de Rabat's back.

summary: 2026 BAL uniform (Season 6), league-controlled: PUMA, the BAL's Official Outfitter from the 2026 season, supplies the game uniforms and its logo sits on the right chest, with 'VISIT RWANDA' beneath the FLYERS wordmark on the front (BAL's own team photo of the Flyers; pr.nba.com, 19 Jun 2023, on the RDB deal; Zawya/APO, 17 Mar 2026, on PUMA), and Qatar Foundation's Sidra tree logo on all BAL team uniforms (Arab News, 14 May 2026; upper-back position visible on a Season 6 jersey in the league's Day 12 recap photo). No club-level shirt sponsor: the BAL supplies all team apparel, and the team photo shows no further commercial logos on the front or the shorts. sponsorsComplete true on that basis; the back was checked via the league-wide statement and league photo, not a Maktown-specific photo.
